package.title: How to hand in your files
package.help: In the competition, judges collect only the Results folder. Practising the same layout means no file gets missed.
package.intro: This test takes ONE ZIP file of your Results folder, laid out like the real competition:
package.s1: Download the template ZIP and unzip it. Rename CODE to your competitor code.
package.s2: Save each finished file in the right folder as you go. Export a STEP file of every part too, so we can check it automatically.
package.s3: Before time runs out, zip the whole folder.
package.s4: Upload that one ZIP here. We show what we found and what is missing.
package.limits: One ZIP, up to 300 MB and 500 files. Native CAD files, renders and animations are kept for the trainer; they are never opened or run on our servers.

rules.alone: Work alone. Don't ask anyone for help and don't share your files.
rules.software: Use any CAD software that exports STEP, such as Inventor, Fusion or SOLIDWORKS.
rules.density: Set the material density given in each task, so the mass is right.
rules.oneFile: Upload one file per task, in the file type the task asks for.
rules.oneZip: Upload ONE ZIP of your Results folder, in the layout shown above.
rules.replace: You can replace a file as often as you like until you submit.
rules.timer: The {minutes}-minute timer runs on our server. Closing the page does not pause it.
rules.autoSubmit: When time runs out, the test is submitted for you.
rules.grace: Uploads that finish within {seconds} seconds after the end still count.
rules.retake: You can take this test again {days} days after your last attempt.

conduct.phone: No phone, smartwatch or wireless headphones.
conduct.devices: No messages or calls with anyone while the test runs.
conduct.usb: No USB sticks on studio computers.
conduct.help: No help from trainers or other competitors during the test.

whatToUpload.step: One STEP file (.step or .stp), modelled in mm.
whatToUpload.pdf: One PDF file of your drawing (.pdf).
whatToUpload.none: Nothing to upload for this task.

package.title: Your Results ZIP
package.help: Zip your whole competition folder (CODE / DAY 01 / Results). We read the list of files inside; nothing is opened or run.
package.intro: Upload one ZIP of your Results folder. You can replace it until you submit. After each upload we check what is inside.
package.label: Results ZIP

errors.too_large: The files in the ZIP add up to more than 2 GB. Remove large working files and zip again.
errors.empty: The ZIP has no files inside.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read this ZIP. Zip the folder again and upload the new file.
errors.not_zip: This file isn't a ZIP. Zip your Results folder and upload the .zip file.
